headline_marked: [[Pure CSS Charts]] Rendered With No JavaScript Or Libraries
headline: Pure CSS Charts Rendered With No JavaScript Or Libraries
summary: st-core.fscss offers a lightweight, zero-JS solution for multi-series line charts, using only CSS variables and custom properties for dynamic updates.
details: Introducing st-core.fscss, a novel charting system that renders multi-line charts entirely in CSS, eliminating the need for JavaScript charting libraries, SVG, or Canvas.

The system utilizes a single @st-chart-line renderer, with each element matching the class becoming an independent line. X positions are fixed, and Y values are provided on a 0-100 scale, internally inverted for CSS coordinates.
By declaring @st-root() once, the system injects essential CSS custom properties. These tokens can be globally overridden or scoped to individual charts, offering high customization.

A key feature is the ability to update any line dynamically by simply writing new CSS properties, as the data lives within CSS variables. The browser automatically repaints the clip-path, negating the need for a redraw library.
This approach results in an extremely lightweight, near-zero-JS runtime for multi-series line charts. The repository and examples are available for developers to explore and contribute.

headline_marked: AirBuddy 3 adds [[Action HUD and Now Playing]] for AirPods and more
headline: AirBuddy 3 adds Action HUD and Now Playing for AirPods and more
summary: The latest version of AirBuddy brings deeper automation and expanded device management to your Mac, with new widgets and a revamped interface.
details: AirBuddy 3 is now available for Mac, offering enhanced control over AirPods and other nearby Apple devices. This update introduces a new Action HUD, providing quick access to controls and information directly on your screen.
Users can now leverage new widgets for even more convenient access to AirBuddy's features. The 'Now Playing' integration allows for seamless control of music and media playback directly from the app.

Deeper automation capabilities have been added, enabling users to create more complex workflows involving their Apple devices. This includes custom triggers and actions based on device status and user interaction.

The app's interface has been refreshed for a more intuitive user experience. AirBuddy 3 aims to streamline the management of multiple Apple devices, making it easier to switch between them and control their functions.
